edges.notes: Generated swagger-typescript-api client (committed source, ADR-0209): users.usersList's this.request({ path: `/users`, method: "GET" }) fixes the path; HttpClient.request (line 405) builds `${baseUrl || this.baseUrl}${path}` and calls customFetch's fetch (line 306), the helper's inner request. The class default baseUrl is "http://localhost:3000/api" (line 302), the example's own `next dev` (default port 3000, example/.env says the same). Never instantiated in the repo, but a request written in repo source. /api/users is served by the pages-router catch-all, whose handler hands every method to NextCrud: ALL
usersCreate: this.request({ path: `/users`, method: "POST" }) on the localhost:3000/api default base; pages/api catch-all, ALL
usersDetail: this.request({ path: `/users/${id}`, method: "GET" }); pages/api catch-all, ALL
usersUpdate: this.request({ path: `/users/${id}`, method: "PUT" }); pages/api catch-all, ALL
usersDelete: this.request({ path: `/users/${id}`, method: "DELETE" }); pages/api catch-all, ALL

postsDelete: this.request({ path: `/posts/${id}`, method: "DELETE" }); pages/api catch-all, ALL

onCustomUserHandler: fetch('/api/users/custom'), root-relative. Next serves the literal pages/api/users/custom.ts before the [...nextcrud] catch-all. Its handler's whole body is if (req.method === 'GET') { … } with no else, so it serves only GET (like a switch on req.method with no default)
